helpCentre.title: Help Centre
helpCentre.intro: Need a hand? Here's how to reach us and answers to common questions.
helpCentre.contactDescription: Email our team and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.
helpCentre.faq1Question: How do I reset my password?
helpCentre.faq1Answer: Go to Settings > Change Password, or use "Forgot password" on the sign-in screen.
helpCentre.faq2Question: How do I make my account private?
helpCentre.faq2Answer: Go to Settings > Privacy and turn on Private account.
helpCentre.faq3Question: How do I delete my account?
helpCentre.faq3Answer: Go to Settings, scroll to the bottom, and tap Delete account.

privacyPolicyScreen.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicyScreen.body:
Lumina respects your privacy. We only collect what's needed to run the app — your profile, posts, and the activity you choose to share — and we never sell your data to third parties. You can request a copy of your data or delete your account at any time from Settings.

For questions about this policy, contact us at the address below.
